The Dean, Research & Development
Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati

Subject: Endorsement for Project Proposal - {{ doc.project_title }}

Dear Sir/Madam,

This is to endorse the project proposal titled "{{ doc.project_title }}", submitted by {{ doc.principal_investigator_name if doc.principal_investigator_name else 'N/A' }} (Employee ID: {{ doc.pi_employee_id if doc.pi_employee_id else 'N/A' }}), from the Department of {{ doc.applicant_department if doc.applicant_department else 'N/A' }}.

Project Type: {{ doc.project_type if doc.project_type else 'N/A' }} {% if doc.project_type == 'Other' and doc.other_project_type_name %} ({{ doc.other_project_type_name }}) {% endif %}

The project aims to achieve the following objectives:

{{ doc.project_objective if doc.project_objective else 'No objective provided.' }}

The proposed deliverables include:

{{ doc.project_deliverables if doc.project_deliverables else 'No deliverables provided.' }}

Executive Summary:

{{ doc.executive_summary if doc.executive_summary else 'No executive summary provided.' }}

Funding Agency: {{ doc.funding_agen if doc.funding_agen else 'N/A' }} {% if doc.funding_agency_schemes %}(Scheme: {{ doc.funding_agency_schemes }}){% endif %}
Type of Funding: {{ doc.funding_agency_type if doc.funding_agency_type else 'N/A' }}
Origin of Funding: {{ doc.origin_of_funding_agency if doc.origin_of_funding_agency else 'N/A' }}
Ministry: {{ doc.funding_agency_ministry if doc.funding_agency_ministry else 'N/A' }}

The project is proposed for a duration of {{ doc.project_duration_months if doc.project_duration_months else 0 }} months and {{ doc.project_duration_days if doc.project_duration_days else 0 }} days.

The estimated total budget for the project is {{ frappe.format(doc.grand_total_proposal, "Currency") if doc.grand_total_proposal else frappe.format(0, "Currency") }}.

We confirm that all necessary internal procedures have been followed, and the project aligns with the objectives of our institution. We request your kind consideration and approval for this project.




Sincerely,

__________________________

{{ doc.principal_investigator_name if doc.principal_investigator_name else 'Principal Investigator' }}

Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati

Dean, Research & Development
Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati
